name: W. W. Mabee
bio: W. W. Mabee of the Glendive Times attended the April 1885 stock meeting and was elected secretary of the North of Yellowstone meeting. The Cow Boy disputed one of his statements in September 1885, and he attended the April 1886 Little Missouri River Stockgrowers' meeting.

W. W. Mabee, of the Glendive Times attended the stock meeting yesterday.
